description: Golden fixtures for Degrees of Success calculation (PF2e Remaster).

cases.description: Margin >= 10: Critical Success (pure math, no nat result)
cases.rule: §2.1: resultado >= DC + 10 → Critical Success (25 >= 15+10=25)

cases.description: Margin == 10 exactly: Critical Success boundary
cases.rule: §2.1: resultado >= DC + 10 → Critical Success (25 >= 25); margin==10 is inclusive boundary

cases.description: Margin >= 0 but < 10: Success
cases.rule: §2.1: resultado >= DC (18 >= 15) mas < DC+10 (18 < 25) → Success

cases.description: Margin == 0 exactly: Success (equal to DC = success)
cases.rule: §2.1: resultado >= DC → Success; margin 0 is still a success (equal to DC counts)

cases.description: Margin > -10 but < 0: Failure
cases.rule: §2.1: resultado < DC (12 < 15) mas > DC-10 (12 > 5) → Failure

cases.description: Margin == -9 exactly: Failure boundary (not yet CritFailure)
cases.rule: §2.1: resultado < DC mas >= DC-10+1; margin=-9 is still Failure, not Critical Failure

cases.description: Margin <= -10: Critical Failure
cases.rule: §2.1: resultado < DC - 10 (4 < 5) → Critical Failure

cases.description: Margin == -10 exactly: Critical Failure boundary
cases.rule: §2.1: resultado < DC - 10; margin=-10 → Critical Failure (strict less than means DC-10 is CritFail)

cases.description: Natural 20: Failure → Success (upgrade one degree)
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 20 sobe um grau; sem nat20 isso seria Failure (margin=-5), com nat20 vira Success

cases.description: Natural 20: Success → Critical Success (upgrade one degree)
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 20 sobe um grau; sem nat20 seria Success (margin=3), com nat20 vira CriticalSuccess

cases.description: Natural 20: Critical Failure → Failure (upgrade one degree, cannot exceed Success without margin)
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 20 sobe um grau; sem nat20 seria CriticalFailure (margin=-13), com nat20 vira Failure

cases.description: Natural 20 already at Critical Success: stays Critical Success (clamped)
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 20 sobe um grau; já era CriticalSuccess (margin=15), permanece CriticalSuccess (max grau)

cases.description: Natural 1: Success → Failure (downgrade one degree)
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 1 desce um grau; sem nat1 seria Success (margin=3), com nat1 vira Failure

cases.description: Natural 1: Critical Success → Success (downgrade one degree)
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 1 desce um grau; sem nat1 seria CriticalSuccess (margin=13), com nat1 vira Success

cases.description: Natural 1: Failure → Critical Failure (downgrade one degree)
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 1 desce um grau; sem nat1 seria Failure (margin=-3), com nat1 vira CriticalFailure

cases.description: Natural 1 already at Critical Failure: stays Critical Failure (clamped)
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 1 desce um grau; já era CriticalFailure (margin=-13), permanece CriticalFailure (min grau)

cases.description: Natural 20 but margin would be CriticalSuccess anyway: stays CriticalSuccess
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 20 com margin=11 já seria CriticalSuccess; upgrade de CriticalSuccess é no-op (clamped)

cases.description: Natural 20: raw roll would be Failure by big margin but nat20 lifts to Success
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 20 sobe um grau; margin=-8 (Failure), com nat20 → Success. Só sobe UM grau independente da margem.

cases.description: Natural 1: raw roll would be Success but nat1 drops to Failure
cases.rule: §2.2: Natural 1 desce um grau; margin=5 (Success), com nat1 → Failure. Só desce UM grau.

cases.description: Exact DC boundary with nat1: Success would be downgraded to Failure
cases.rule: §2.1 + §2.2: margin=0 → Success; mas nat1 desce para Failure. Nat1 é aplicado antes de quaisquer outros efeitos.
